app.name: Bliss
app.description: A warm, nature-inspired wedding planning companion. Step by step through the garden.

marketing.subhead: Bliss guides you through every stage of planning, from first vision to wedding day, like a calm friend who has done this before.
marketing.ctaNote: Free to start. No credit card required.

dreamFirst.title: Dream first, budget later
dreamFirst.body: We start with your vision. Budget comes after, framed as how to make it happen, not a ceiling.

oneStep.title: {count} quests, one step at a time
oneStep.body: Every quest is open from day one. You always know what to do next, and what can wait.

multicultural.title: Built for two families
multicultural.body: Blending traditions? Pick your heritages and Bliss adds the right events, vendors, and lead times.

quote.text: Bliss feels like a friend who has already been through it.

hero.body: A wedding is a year of small decisions made by two people who have never made them before. Bliss stays next to you for all of it — curious about what you actually want, useful when it gets heavy, and careful to remember why each choice mattered.
hero.note: Two people, one workspace. Nothing is hidden from each other.

rings.label: Two rings that meet where the two of you agree
rings.start: Two people. One story you have not written yet.
rings.named: {selfName} and {partnerName}. Two voices, kept separate on purpose.
rings.date: The day your shared story changed direction.
rings.ready: Where you agree, Bliss ties the knot and remembers why.

together.title: A journey with two authors
together.body: You will not always want the same thing, and that is not a problem to fix. Bliss keeps both preferences visible, names the real trade-off, and never quietly picks a side.

unexpected.title: Room left for surprise
unexpected.body: The parts you will retell are rarely the parts you planned. Bliss handles the tedious scaffolding so there is still air in the year for something you did not see coming.

kept.title: A memory that outlives the planning
kept.body: Every decision keeps its reason. Long after the spreadsheets are gone, you will still know why you chose the small room, the late dinner, or the song.

chapters.title: Fourteen chapters, opened when you are ready
chapters.body: Not four hundred tasks. Each chapter holds a few real decisions, and the work only appears after the two of you have shaped it.
chapters.label: The fourteen wedding chapters
chapters.note: Bliss will never rush you into the next chapter. Whenever you open one, it makes sure you have what you need to decide well.

entry.title: Start with your names. That is genuinely all.
entry.body: No plan to build, no questionnaire to survive. Bliss asks one thing at a time, and the first two are easy.

encourage.title: Encourage
encourage.body: notice real progress without treating you like a child.

help.title: Help
help.body: draft the email, compare the quotes, and do the dull parts.

support.title: Support
support.body: represent both of you accurately, especially when you disagree.

remember.title: Remember
remember.body: keep the reason behind every choice you make.

names.title: What should Bliss call you two?
names.body: Your names stay attached to whatever each of you says, so neither of you disappears into a shared account.
names.assurance: You can invite your partner later. Nothing is shared until you do.

engagement.title: When did you say yes?
engagement.body: The day you got engaged becomes the first Moment in your story. Bliss counts forward from here, not down.
engagement.label: The day it happened
engagement.assurance: You can change or remove this at any time.

handoff.noted: Noted — {timing}. Nothing is fixed until you confirm it.
handoff.body: One more and then we can just talk: do you have a wedding date in mind yet, or is that still open?
handoff.assurance: Whatever you answer, nothing gets locked in. Bliss only records what you confirm.

footer.tagline: Bliss — a planning companion for two.

money.regionalNote: Costs vary a lot by region. Expect higher in NY, CA, and NJ, lower in the Midwest and South.

time.leadTime: Book {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} out

join.title: Joining your wedding plan
join.redirecting: Taking you to your shared plan.
